kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserquell in Kirchdorf in Tirol offers family-friendly swimming fun and sauna indulgence with views of the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung:
Refreshment and Well-Being in Kirchdorf

The Wellnesszentrum Kaiserquell in Kirchdorf in Tirol is a popular oasis for families, water lovers, and relaxation seekers in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Located directly by the Großache, the complex offers an unobstructed view of the mighty massif of the Wilder Kaiser.

Swimming Fun and Sauna World

In summer, the heated outdoor pool attracts visitors with a 50-metre-long giant water slide, massage jets, and a safe paddling pool for children. The modern sauna landscape, featuring a Finnish sauna, organic Swiss stone pine sauna, and aroma steam bath, provides pure year-round relaxation after an extensive mountain tour.
